finalText:
I worked all 16 open RMAs: 12 are settled and closed, 4 are still open.

**Closed, refunded and restocked**

| RMA | Refund | Method | Fee | Stock |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 801 | 10,965 | card | 15% | P-KEY sellable |
| 802 | 15,900 | card | none (PU-21) | P-HDP sellable |
| 803 | 27,965 | store credit, applied to the balance | 15% | P-MON sellable |
| 804 | 27,965 | store credit, applied to the balance | 15% | P-MON sellable |
| 805 | 5,520 | card | 20% (PU-15) | P-HUB sellable |
| 806 | 7,350 | card | none (defective) | P-MOU ×2 damaged |
| 810 | 9,900 | card | none (defective) | P-KEY damaged |
| 811 | 4,900 | card | none | P-MOU sellable |
| 812 | 21,900 | card | none | P-DOC damaged |
| 813 | 10,965 | card | 15% | P-KEY sellable |
| 814 | 31,800 | card | none (PU-21) | P-HDP ×2 sellable |
| 815 | 10,965 | card | 15% | P-KEY sellable |

- **803 and 804:** shipped 41 days before the request, which is outside the 30-day window, so they were paid as store credit. The customer on 803 became gold only on 2026-07-15, after requesting on 07-08, so PU-18 doesn't apply.
- **810:** I refunded 9,900 because 3,000 had already been refunded on that line.
- **815:** the customer is platinum, so PU-18 gives a 45-day window and the 38 days since shipping qualifies for a card refund.
- **813:** requested exactly 30 days after shipping, which is still inside the window.

**Left open**
- **RMA-808:** the warehouse received P-CAB, but the return covers P-MON. I opened investigation INV-1 and refunded and restocked nothing.
- **RMA-809:** 2 of the 3 units have arrived (1 resellable, 1 damaged). I refunded 3,800 card with no fee under PU-21 and restocked each unit by grade. The return stays open for the third unit.
- **RMA-807 and RMA-816:** no units received yet, so I changed nothing.

I did not reply to any customers or send notices, because the task only covered settling the RMAs.
